title: CIL Mode Switch Surface Capability Record
description: Per-surface capability evidence. This package ships the MODEL only. A record instance is written into the install-bound evidence home at install time and is never supplied as an argument to an evaluation call.

capability.description: A proof-bearing state — PROVEN or NOT_APPLICABLE — is a positive claim about the surface. It must also carry directEvidence, an evidenceBasis that classifies the surface, an evidencePath contained by the evidence home, and an evidenceIdentity that is the SHA-256 of that artifact's bytes. Those extra requirements live in validateCapabilityRecord, because a path and a digest can only be resolved against a specific evidence home.

evidenceIdentity.description: Durable content identity of the cited evidence artifact, as sha256:<64 lowercase hex>. Required for a proof-bearing state. A free-text label is not an identity.

evidenceBasis.description: What the state rests on. SURFACE_INSPECTED and SURFACE_DOCUMENTED classify the surface itself. EVALUATOR_NO_READ_PATH says only that the evaluating actor could not inspect the surface; that is UNKNOWN, and never a proof-bearing state.

evidencePath.description: Evidence artifact, relative to the evidence home. It may not be absolute and may not escape the home.
